name: Sanjou Ayame
source:
Occupation: Volunteer Department
Role: Control Tower

Sanjou's magical girl identity. Her thinking is as fast as a computer and relays to her teammates with telepathic communication.

Her magical abilities are "Telepath" (テレパス) and "Accelerator" (アクセラレータ).
